title: Canonical exact structures and shift compatibility of the restricted scalar mate
statement: Let $f:Z\to T$ be a morphism of schemes and let $a:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative ring sheaves on $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$. Put $A_Z=f^{-1}A$, $B_Z=f^{-1}B$ and $a_Z=f^{-1}a$. Use module sheaves and ordinary unbounded derived categories. Let $t,z$ be signed-total tensor presentations on $D(A)$ and $D(A_Z)$, respectively. Let $T_T,T_Z$ be the canonical derived scalar extensions for $a,a_Z$, and let $r_T$ be scalar restriction. Use the normalized scalar/tensor identifications and the prescribed geometric adjunction mate $\beta$ [lem-sfb-derived-scalar-tensor-identification]. Write $F=T_T\circ Rf_{*,A}$ and $H=Rf_{*,B}\circ T_Z$. There exist coherent integer shift structures on the two tensor bifunctors, normalized on flat-term K-flat representatives by the signed-total shifts (including the unsigned first-factor shift), a shift on $Rf_{*,A}$ compatible with the fixed geometric pullback shift and its adjunction, and shift structures on $r_TF$ and $r_TH$, such that the specified sourceIso and targetIso commute with shifts, both restricted functors are triangulated, and the prescribed restricted scalar mate $r_T\beta$ commutes with every integer shift [def-weil-triangulated-category]. These are exactly CanonicalTensorShifts and the CommShift structures in the attached declaration. This asserts neither the projection equality nor any isomorphism-locus closure; those are separate arguments.

source.place: Tags 06YY (lemma-derived-base-change), 07A4 (lemma-pullback-tensor-product), 07A6 (lemma-adjoint); ordinary tensor normalization in sites-modules.tex, Tag 03EK. The compatibility calculations below are agent-written expansions, not verbatim claims of the source.

proof.text: Construct a normalized global tensor model on each native pro-etale site using tensorModelWithShifts_nonempty. Its TensorShifts fields give MateCanonicalShiftData by canceling the shifted inverse representative. The resolving descent bijection lifts the isomorphism from the prescribed representative of t (respectively z) to this model. Apply mateTensorShiftOfIso and mateCanonicalShiftTransport to transfer coherent tensor shifts and both signed representative normalizations to t and z. These are private proved helpers normalized_global and native_shifts in the attached module.

Keep the fixed exact-derived pullback shift and install Adjunction.rightAdjointCommShift and commShift_of_leftAdjoint. Apply the native first-variable projection theorem at P=Q(coefficientComplex a) to get exact projection functors and the shift-compatible transformation pi with its prescribed projection components.

Transport the two projection functor shifts backwards along sourceIso and targetIso using Functor.CommShift.ofIso. Its compatibility theorem gives CommShift for the inverse isomorphisms, hence also the forward isomorphisms. Functor.isTriangulated_of_iso transports both exactness statements. The scalar projection normalization and cancellation of the two component isomorphisms prove that restricted beta equals sourceIso.hom followed by pi followed by targetIso.inv. Closure of CommShift under composition gives the final assertion, with no invertibility of beta.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarMate_canonical_exact_structures
    {Z T : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ T)
    {A B : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}} (a : A ⟶ B)
    (t : ProEtaleTensorModel T A) (z : ProEtaleTensorModel Z (inverseRing f A)) :
    (∃ (_ : (Functor.curryObj t.tensor).CommShift₂Int)
        (_ : (Functor.curryObj z.tensor).CommShift₂Int)
        (_ : (push f A).CommShift ℤ)
        (_ : ((push f A ⋙ proEtaleRingDerivedExtension a) ⋙
          (restriction a).mapDerivedCategory).CommShift ℤ)
        (_ : ((proEtaleRingDerivedExtension (inverseMap f a) ⋙ push f B) ⋙
          (restriction a).mapDerivedCategory).CommShift ℤ),
      CanonicalTensorShifts t ∧ CanonicalTensorShifts z ∧
      (adjunction f A).CommShift ℤ ∧
      NatTrans.CommShift (sourceIso f a t).hom ℤ ∧
      NatTrans.CommShift (targetIso f a z).hom ℤ ∧
      ((push f A ⋙ proEtaleRingDerivedExtension a) ⋙
        (restriction a).mapDerivedCategory).IsTriangulated ∧
      ((proEtaleRingDerivedExtension (inverseMap f a) ⋙ push f B) ⋙
        (restriction a).mapDerivedCategory).IsTriangulated ∧
      NatTrans.CommShift (Functor.whiskerRight (beta f a)
        (restriction a).mapDerivedCategory) ℤ)
